data.text: I’m willing to join. I commit to harvesting 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided Emma also commits and Luke keeps his catch at zero. I’ll share the payment receipt here. My family taught me to protect both the lake and the neighbors who depend on it, so I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month under our combined 30-ton recovery cap, then the 50-ton monthly ceiling afterward. Emma, can you make the final pledge before anyone fishes?
